_doc: Vel Morrath, the holy city (the user's spec of 2026-11-06, docs/vel_morrath.txt): its people and quests. 892 writes them into the brokenspire level's generator as townsfolk and quests of the town "Vel Morrath" (FRDTownsfolkDef::Town, FRDQuestDef::Town): a role it has people for takes those in its posts (RDTownPlan.cpp's holy city), the others the shared ones. The functional ones: the archbishop (the Elder's part: talk, quests), the archivist (the Scholar's), the templar commander (the Captain's), the trades' keepers (their services). The quests count the catacombs' own counters ("vel_morrath:enter", ":tier", ":kills", ":boss").

townsfolk.name: VM_Archbishop
townsfolk.title: Archbishop Severin Aurel
lines: Peace be upon you, traveller. Few come to Vel Morrath with a sword these days, and fewer leave with one.
The bells ring at every hour, so the dead below know we have not forgotten them.
topics: What lies beneath the cathedral?|The catacombs. Our founders buried their saints there, then their bishops, then everyone. Each generation dug a floor deeper. No map we hold goes to the bottom.

Why do you need me?|Something is climbing. The lowest stair was sealed a century ago; last winter the seal was found broken from below. The templars hold the first floor. They cannot hold what they cannot reach.
How do I get down?|Through the choir, behind the high altar. The stair is open to anyone who asks. Coming back up is the hard part.

townsfolk.name: VM_Archivist
townsfolk.title: Archivist Mott
lines: Mind the ink. The records do not forgive a blot, and neither do I.
Every floor below us was mapped once. The maps of the deepest ones have all burned. Twice.
topics: How deep do the catacombs go?|The old surveys counted five floors before the ink stops. The monks' diaries speak of stairs past the fifth. The diaries stop too.
Who were the dead below?|Saints and sinners, side by side. The founders believed the holy dead would keep the rest asleep. I am no longer sure they meant asleep.

townsfolk.name: VM_Commander
townsfolk.title: Commander Ysolde Vane
lines: Templars do not retreat. We fall back to the next stair, and the next.
If you go down, go down armed and come up counted.
topics: What do the templars face below?|Bones that walk, and worse things that wear them. Each floor down they are stronger, as if the dark feeds them.
How do I help?|Clear what you can. Kill the warden of each floor. Bring me word the stairs still stand.

townsfolk.name: VM_Priestess
townsfolk.title: Mother Ilsabet
lines: Kneel, child. The light asks only that you return to it.
A blessing costs little. Going down without one costs more.

townsfolk.name: VM_Smith
townsfolk.title: Garrick Tull
lines: Bone dulls a blade faster than you would think. Bring it here before it fails you.
Templar steel, pilgrim prices. Mostly.

townsfolk.name: VM_Trader
townsfolk.title: Ansel the Chandler
townsfolk.calling: seller of candles, oils and other things
lines: Candles for the dead, potions for the living. Both sell well here.
Pilgrims buy the candles. Templars buy the potions. You look like a potion buyer.

townsfolk.name: VM_Healer
townsfolk.title: Sister Brenna
lines: Sit. Whatever bit you down there, I have seen worse. Twice this week.
The wounds from below do not close cleanly. Let me see.

townsfolk.name: VM_Keeper
townsfolk.title: Wardkeeper Holt
lines: What you leave with me stays with me. The dead are not the only ones who keep things here.

townsfolk.name: VM_Innkeeper
townsfolk.title: Matron Gilda
lines: A bed, a bowl and a prayer, in whatever order you need them.
Pilgrims come to see the cathedral. You came for what is under it. I can tell.

townsfolk.name: VM_Preacher
townsfolk.title: Brother Aldous
lines: The dead below us are not resting. They are waiting. Pray they wait a little longer.
Light the candles! Every flame is a door they cannot pass.

townsfolk.name: VM_Monk1
townsfolk.title: a monk
lines: Silence is a prayer too.
We copy the old maps by candlelight. They are wrong, mostly. We copy them anyway.

townsfolk.name: VM_Monk2
townsfolk.title: a nun
lines: The bells will ring for you, if you do not come back up.
We pray for the ones below. All of them.

townsfolk.name: VM_Pilgrim1
townsfolk.title: a pilgrim
lines: Three hundred miles on foot to see these spires. Worth every step.
They say if you listen at the choir's stair, you can hear them singing below.

townsfolk.name: VM_Pilgrim2
townsfolk.title: a pilgrim
lines: I came to pray for my brother. The templars say he went down the stair a month ago.
Have you lit a candle yet? You should.

townsfolk.name: VM_Pilgrim3
townsfolk.title: a pilgrim
lines: The relics are said to heal the lame. My knees have not noticed yet.
So many bells. Do they ever stop?

townsfolk.name: VM_Pilgrim4
townsfolk.title: a pilgrim
lines: I slept in the plaza. The statues watched me all night.
Blessings on your road, stranger.

townsfolk.name: VM_Beggar1
townsfolk.title: a beggar
lines: Alms, for the love of the saints below.
A coin for a blind man? I saw what is under that altar once. Once was enough.

townsfolk.name: VM_Beggar2
townsfolk.title: a beggar
lines: The priests eat well. We eat what the pilgrims drop.
Spare a crust, and I will pray you come back up.

townsfolk.name: VM_Beggar3
townsfolk.title: a beggar
lines: I was a templar once. Third floor. Do not go to the third floor.
Alms, alms.

townsfolk.name: VM_Templar1
townsfolk.title: a templar
lines: Pass in peace. Return in peace, if you can.
The stair is open. Our orders are to let anyone down. Nobody said anything about up.

townsfolk.name: VM_Templar2
townsfolk.title: a templar
lines: Stand clear of the door. Pilgrims first.
Light keeps. Steel keeps. Faith keeps. Pick at least two.

townsfolk.name: VM_Guard1
townsfolk.title: a templar sentry
lines: Welcome to Vel Morrath. Keep your blade sheathed in the plaza.
Move along, pilgrim.

townsfolk.name: VM_Guard2
townsfolk.title: a templar sentry
lines: The cathedral is that way. You cannot miss it. Nobody ever has.

townsfolk.name: VM_Militia1
townsfolk.title: a templar on the walls
lines: Nothing comes over the walls. It is what comes up the stairs that worries us.

townsfolk.name: VM_Militia2
townsfolk.title: a templar on the walls
lines: Quiet night. They are always quiet, until they are not.

townsfolk.name: VM_Soldier1
townsfolk.title: a templar
lines: Drill, prayer, drill, prayer. Then the stair.

townsfolk.name: VM_Soldier2
townsfolk.title: a templar
lines: Aim for the joints. Bones have no other weakness.

townsfolk.name: VM_Child1
townsfolk.title: Little Agnes
lines: Mother says if I am bad the skeletons will come up and get me.
I can count all the bells! There are forty-one.

townsfolk.name: VM_Child2
townsfolk.title: Benedict
lines: Are you going down the stair? Bring me back a skull!

townsfolk.name: VM_Mourner
townsfolk.title: Widow Maud
lines: He went down to bring back a relic for me. I only wanted him.
The graves up here are the lucky ones.

townsfolk.name: VM_Idiot
townsfolk.title: Mad Ewan
townsfolk.calling: who hears the bells too much
lines: Down, down, down, and the bells go up, up, up!
The floor under the floor under the floor. Nobody has been. I have been. Nobody believes me.

townsfolk.name: VM_Citizen1
townsfolk.title: a citizen
lines: Good day. Mind the pilgrims, they walk without looking.
The candle tax went up again.

townsfolk.name: VM_Citizen2
townsfolk.title: a citizen
lines: We built our houses white so the dead could find their way to the light. Or so they tell the children.

townsfolk.name: VM_Citizen3
townsfolk.title: a citizen
lines: Another adventurer. The last one bought my whole stock of holy water.

quests.title: The Stair Beneath the Altar
quests.offer: The stair behind the high altar leads into the catacombs. Go down, see the first floor with your own eyes, and come back to tell me what you saw. That is all I ask, for now.
quests.done: You came back. That alone is worth something here. Take this, and keep the light about you.
quests.hint: Go down the stair behind the cathedral's high altar

quests.title: Deeper Than the Bells
quests.offer: The second floor was the founders' own. If something is coming up, it has passed through their tombs. Open the way to the second floor.
quests.done: The founders' floor is open again. May they forgive us for the noise.

quests.title: Where the Maps End
quests.offer: Our maps stop at the fourth floor. Below it is only the archivist's guesses and the diaries of men who did not come back. Find the fourth floor, and the stair beyond it.
quests.done: Further than any map. Whatever is climbing, it now knows someone is coming down to meet it.

quests.title: Ash and Bone
quests.offer: My templars cannot hold the first floors and fight the deeper ones. Thin them. Twenty-five of whatever walks down there.
quests.done: Twenty-five fewer. The stair is quieter tonight.

quests.title: The Warden Below
quests.offer: Every floor has something that rules it. Kill one of the wardens, and the rest will know we bite back.
quests.done: A warden down. My templars will drink to you, and then they will pray for you.
quests.hint: Kill a floor's warden in the catacombs

quests.title: What the Monks Wrote
quests.offer: The brothers at the monastery copy the old surveys. Speak to one of them, and ask what the diaries say about the stairs below the fifth floor.
quests.done: So they say the stairs go on. The ink stops. The stairs do not. I was afraid of that.

quests.title: Bounty: Clear the Ossuary
quests.offer: The chandlers' guild offers coin to whoever clears the first ossuary so candles can be laid again.
